name: get_booking
description: Look up a single Horizon Travel booking by its reference code. Use this whenever a traveller asks about a specific booking, reservation, or confirmation number such as 'BK-1001'.

name: list_bookings_by_email
description: List every Horizon Travel booking belonging to one customer email address. Use this when a traveller asks what trips or bookings they have, or asks about another customer's booking history by email.
